title: Point vortex dynamics in quasi-periodic channels: transporting trajectories and ergodic distribution of equilibria
summary: We study the dynamics of a single point vortex in an unbounded planar channel whose interfaces are quasi-periodic in the longitudinal direction. The motion is governed by the Robin function. We introduce a hull formulation that lifts the quasi-periodic geometry to a periodic problem on a finite-dimensional torus and yields an exact quasi-periodic representation of the Robin function.
